es.title: Corvera será la sede en abril de un encuentro juvenil autonómico
es.description: El Ayuntamiento de Corvera conmemoró este viernes 20 de noviembre el día internacional de la Infancia con una jornada dedicada a la participación, los derechos y la inclusión de los menores. Los actos se han desarrollado en el Teatro El Llar de Las Vegas con la celebración de una sesión del consejo local de Infancia y Adolescencia y la entrega de premios de los concursos de fotografía y carteles que promueve Difac. El consejo de Infancia y Adolescencia, presidido por la vicealcaldesa y concejala de Juventud y Acción Social, Patricia Suárez, es el espacio en el que los grupos de participación infantil y juvenil comparten sus inquietudes, hacen llegar sus propuestas al Ayuntamiento y diseñan iniciativas para mejorar su entorno. Corvera acogerá el próximo mes de abril el encuentro autonómico de juventud. es.title: @mi_heroe_juan
es.description: Ellas Cuentan. No es una frase hecha. Es una iniciativa solidaria de CINFA y el Club de Malasmadres que, desde 2021, busca dar visibilidad y reconocer a mujeres que afrontan situaciones complejas derivadas de una enfermedad o que cuidan de hijos con dolencias o necesidades especiales. Las mujeres seleccionadas reciben una aportación económica para mejorar su calidad de vida. Con esta iniciativa se busca dar voz a realidades que no siempre se ven y que, muchas veces, se viven en soledad. Quiero contarte la historia de CRISTINA PÉREZ y de su hijo JUAN. Juan tiene síndrome CDG, una enfermedad genética rara que puede afectar a distintos órganos y sistemas del organismo. Su familia tuvo que aprender a convivir con esta realidad que exige organización, atención y muchos cuidados. Su madre ha tenido que adaptar su vida a las múltiples necesidades de su hijo. Un camino que, con el paso de los años, ha ido marcando sus decisiones personales y profesionales. Juan tiene reconocido un 95 % de discapacidad y necesita apoyos para desenvolverse en su día a día. A las necesidades médicas se suman las barreras que aparecen fuera de casa, en espacios públicos que no siempre cuentan con las instalaciones necesarias para atender a personas con discapacidad. Cristina conoce bien esos obstáculos y ha decidido dar a conocer una realidad que afecta a muchas familias. Cristina también forma parte de la Asociación Española Síndrome CDG, donde trabaja como tesorera. Desde esa posición conoce de cerca las necesidades de otras familias que conviven con esta enfermedad y las dificultades que comparten a la hora de conseguir atención, recursos y apoyos. Detrás de cada caso hay una familia que necesita respuestas y que, muchas veces, tiene que buscar soluciones por su cuenta. La historia de Cristina refleja las dificultades que afrontan muchas familias para atender las necesidades de sus hijos y la importancia de contar con recursos y apoyos que les permitan afrontar esa realidad con más facilidades. Cristina también comparte su experiencia y la historia de su hijo en Instagram, a través de la cuenta @mi_heroe_juan. Todo con el fin de dar visibilidad a una situación que para mucha gente pasa desapercibida. Cristina es una de las 158 mujeres que han participado en la sexta edición de Ellas Cuentan, una iniciativa que contribuye a que sus historias sean escuchadas y no caigan en el olvido.

pl.title: Odznaczeni za niezłomną postawę
pl.description: W piatek 20 listopada 2026 r. w Krakowie odbyła się uroczystość, podczas której wręczono działaczom 22 Krzyże Wolności i Solidarności oraz 12 Medali Reipublicae Memoriae Meritum. Odznaczenia uhonorowani odebrali z rąk dr. Mateusza Szpytmy, zastępcy prezesa Instytutu Pamięci Narodowej. Wydarzenie zorganizowane przez krakowski oddział Instytutu Pamięci Narodowej odbyło się w gmachu Małopolskiego Urzędu Wojewódzkiego.– Chciałbym, w imieniu państwa polskiego, podziękować Wam za to, że sprzeciwiliście się złu, które trawiło naszą Ojczyznę. Za swoją niezłomną postawę można było przecież stracić pracę, zostać internowanym, aresztowanym. Byli też tacy, których za walkę z komunistycznym systemem zamordowano. Ryzykowaliście więc wiele, nie mając pewności, że ta Niepodległa powstanie. To, że doczekaliście Rzeczpospolitej w 1989 roku, jest chyba zatem największą nagrodą, jaka mogła Was spotkać – mówił podczas uroczystości zastępca prezesa IPN dr Mateusz Szpytma. Uroczystość poprowadził dr hab. Filip Musiał, dyrektor Oddziału IPN w Krakowie.

co.title: El dólar se dispara en Colombia y supera los $3.500 en medio de la incertidumbre fiscal
co.description: El dólar registró una de sus jornadas más fuertes del año en Colombia y volvió a superar la barrera de los $3.500. La divisa alcanzó un máximo de $3.504 durante la negociación, en medio de la incertidumbre sobre las finanzas públicas del país y el fortalecimiento de la moneda estadounidense en los mercados internacionales. Al cierre de la jornada, la tasa representativa del mercado (TRM) se ubicó en $3.415,10, mientras que el dólar terminó las negociaciones en $3.463,18. Esto representó un incremento de $48,08 frente a la TRM vigente. Durante el día, la cotización osciló entre un mínimo de $3.407 y un máximo de $3.504. En total se realizaron 1.396 operaciones por US$1.482 millones. El precio máximo alcanzado por la divisa no se observaba desde el 12 de junio de este año. Además, el movimiento representó la mayor variación diaria desde el 7 de abril de 2025, cuando el dólar subió $100,50, al pasar de $4.274,03 a $4.374,53. Siga leyendo: El dólar frena su escalada en Colombia y cae frente a la TRM: ¿en cuánto se negocia? El comportamiento de la tasa de cambio responde a una combinación de factores externos e internos. En el frente internacional, los inversionistas han aumentado su exposición a activos estadounidenses ante las expectativas de un posible endurecimiento de la política monetaria de la Reserva Federal (Fed). De acuerdo con Reuters, el repunte del dólar comenzó el 10 de noviembre, después de que los datos de inflación de Estados Unidos superaran las expectativas del mercado. Esto fortaleció las apuestas sobre una política monetaria más restrictiva por parte del banco central estadounidense. El jueves, la moneda encontró un nuevo impulso por la venta de activos y divisas considerados de mayor riesgo, mientras los inversionistas buscaban liquidez y refugio en el dólar. “Estamos presenciando una búsqueda frenética de liquidez en dólares estadounidenses y todo el complejo de mercados emergentes está sufriendo una fuerte caída a medida que se soportan las condiciones financieras mundiales”, afirmó Karl Schamotta, estratega jefe de mercado de Corpay. A este escenario se sumaron las declaraciones del gobernador de la Reserva Federal, Christopher Waller, quien pidió el miércoles una respuesta más agresiva frente a la inflación. Las minutas de la reunión del banco central del 27 y 28 de octubre también mostraron una mayor preocupación entre sus integrantes por la posibilidad de necesitar nuevos ajustes monetarios. En el frente local, las dudas sobre las finanzas públicas se convirtieron en otro factor de presión para el peso colombiano. Uno de los elementos que generó incertidumbre es la discusión sobre las fuentes de financiación del Gobierno, especialmente después de que se acordara retirar propuestas de IVA para algunos productos dentro de los cambios tributarios. La decisión abrió interrogantes sobre cómo se cubrirán las necesidades de recaudo de la Nación. En el último mes, el peso colombiano y el real brasileño se ubicaron entre las monedas emergentes con mayores pérdidas frente al dólar, en medio de un entorno de menor apetito por el riesgo. La presión se mantuvo incluso después de que el Ministerio de Hacienda realizara ventas cercanas a US$600 millones en el mercado Next Day. Según el análisis de Acciones & Valores, la elevada aversión global al riesgo y el limitado respaldo de los precios del petróleo impidieron que esas operaciones frenaran el avance de la tasa de cambio. Por su parte, JP Tactical reportó un volumen negociado de US$1.549,9 millones en 1.432 operaciones. Su análisis señaló que la demanda de dólares se mantiene elevada, con la cotización en zona de sobrecompra y un primer nivel de soporte técnico en $3.451. Puede conocer: Dólar en Colombia llegó a máximos de $3.300 tras dato de inflación de Estados Unidos En los mercados externos, el índice DXY, que mide el comportamiento del dólar frente a una canasta de seis monedas, retrocedió 0,11% y se ubicó en 103,76 puntos. Pese a esta leve toma de ganancias, la moneda estadounidense se mantuvo cerca de sus niveles más altos en 19 meses, respaldada por las expectativas sobre las decisiones de la Reserva Federal y la búsqueda de activos considerados más seguros. Sin embargo, algunos estrategas mantienen reservas sobre la posibilidad de que el dólar prolongue su tendencia alcista de manera significativa en el corto plazo. Para que esto ocurra, señalan, sería necesario que aparezcan nuevos factores que impulsen su cotización. Ante este panorama, Sebastián Toro, educador financiero, inversionista y fundador y CEO de Arena Alfa, afirmó que el reciente repunte del dólar en Colombia responde, en parte, a una corrección del desfase que mantenía el peso frente a otras monedas de la región y al comportamiento global de la divisa estadounidense. “Lo raro era que esto no hubiera ocurrido antes. Hace dos o tres meses, cuando el dólar estaba cerca de los $3.000, explicamos que el peso colombiano estaba totalmente desacoplado de monedas como el real brasileño y el peso mexicano. Esa diferencia representaba entre 15% y 20% del precio”, señaló. Según Toro, el movimiento reciente refleja un mayor alineamiento de la tasa de cambio colombiana con el dólar a nivel internacional y con las monedas de otros mercados latinoamericanos. Sin embargo, advirtió que todavía existe una brecha frente a economías como Brasil. “Ya se corrigió un poco ese diferencial tan grande que había con las monedas de la región y con el dólar a nivel global. Si nos alineáramos por completo con Brasil, cuya moneda se disparó tras las elecciones, el dólar tendría que llegar a los $4.000”, explicó. El analista también cuestionó que el peso colombiano hubiera mantenido tanta fortaleza frente al contexto económico del país. “Un peso tan fuerte y desacoplado del mundo y de la región tampoco tenía mucho sentido. El gobierno de Gustavo Petro deja un país con una situación fiscal y de deuda muy complicada, así que tampoco se justificaba un dólar tan barato en Colombia”. in.title: IFFI 57 to focus on ‘Stories Without Borders’
in.description: Panaji, Nov 20: The 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) will focus on the theme ‘Stories Without Borders’, exploring narratives that transcend geographical, social and cultural divisions, Festival Director Ashutosh Gowariker said during a media briefing at the PIB Media Centre in Panaji, Goa. Addressing the media, Gowariker said the theme goes beyond territorial boundaries to highlight divisions within families and societies, including those arising from caste and other socio-cultural differences. The festival aims to bring together stories reflecting shared human experiences across cultures. He announced the introduction of three new sections—Animation, Documentary and Films about Films—to expand the festival's cinematic offerings and provide greater visibility to different forms of filmmaking. Emphasising the importance of documentaries, Gowariker said the festival would also host a special gala presentation featuring films by winners of the recently concluded Mumbai International Film Festival (MIFF). He encouraged media professionals to explore different sections of the festival, including retrospectives, curated showcases, gala screenings and international press conferences, while maintaining independent and critical perspectives in their coverage. Gowariker also highlighted the role of media in taking the festival's cinematic offerings to wider audiences and said arrangements had been made to facilitate flexible interactions between media representatives and the festival team. During the briefing, Gowariker unveiled the official brochure of the 57th edition of IFFI. The media interaction was moderated by Smita Vats Sharma, Director General (West), Press Information Bureau, and attended by Dhiraj Singh, Managing Director, National Film Development Corporation (NFDC).

in.title: When Neetu Kapoor spoke about daughter Riddhima Kapoor Sahni's habit of getting irritated with chewing sounds
in.description: Mumbai, Nov 21 (IANS) Veteran actress Neetu Kapoor once spoke about her daughter Riddhima Kapoor Sahni’s habit of nitpicking, and getting irritated by the chewing sound. An old clip from one of Kapil Sharma’s shows has resurfaced on the Internet, and it shows the veteran actress recollecting her ordeal of sitting on the dinner table with her daughter. She said, “Let me tell you a very interesting story about Ridhima. So, Ridhima is a very proper girl. If you are sitting at the dining table, and you are eating food, she would want you to close your mouth while eating. And if you eat papad, you will hear the sound, right? She gets very angry. She says, ‘Oh, my God. So disgusting’. She does this to me. So, Ranveer and I felt very bad. Their father didn't bother. He was like, ‘Let her say whatever she wants’. So, she used to roll her eyes, lift her plate, and sit separately. She used to say, ‘I can't take this’”. Riddhima is elder to Bollywood star Ranbir Kapoor. She married the Delhi-based businessman Bharat Sahni, and has a daughter, Samara. Custom Ad: Multiplex Neetu Kapoor shared, “Now, she has a daughter. A mother will feed her child. And the child is young, she will naturally make noise while eating. So, Ranbir and I were very happy. And we used to say, ‘Now, say it. Now, what? Now, roll your eyes’. Payback time”. “We used to get so scared. Our entire life, she has tortured us by saying, ‘Don't eat papad. Don't eat wafers. Shut your mouth. Sit like this. Do like this’. Oh, my God”, she added. Meanwhile, Riddhima recently made her acting debut with ‘Daadi Ki Shaadi’, in which she starred alongside her mother Neetu Kapoor and comedian-actor Kapil Sharma. --IANS aa/

sg.title: GEYOTO Wraps Up RE+ 2026 Debut with Strong Visitor Engagement and Real-World Product Experiences
sg.description: From creator coverage and product demonstrations to an artist-painted N1000, GEYOTO's Las Vegas debut connected energy innovation with everyday needs. LAS VEGAS, Nov. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- GEYOTO concluded its first appearance at RE+ 2026 with an active booth, interest among content creators and visitors, and product experiences that brought its "Go-to Energy" philosophy to life. During the Nov. 17–19 exhibition at the Las Vegas Convention Center, attendees stopped to photograph the booth, explore new products and speak with the team about energy needs at home and outdoors. A First Appearance That Gave Visitors a Reason to Stop At Booth C4753, sandstone textures and warm desert tones gave GEYOTO an American Southwest-inspired setting. The oversized "YO!" installation at the front added a playful welcome, expressing the brand's lively, approachable personality and giving visitors another reason to stop and take a photo. Content creators, including @911Reviews and @Minute Man Solar, visited the booth to explore and record the new lineup. Alongside invited creators, other attendees passing through the exhibition also stopped to film and photograph the products, drawn to their distinctive designs. Attendees shared their own photos and posts on social media, carrying their impressions of GEYOTO beyond the exhibition floor. Creators at the Booth This interest also led to conversations with distributors, retailers and solar industry professionals about product applications and potential North American partnerships, giving the team opportunities to continue discussions beyond the show. Product Stories That Went Beyond the Specification Sheet The N1500X demonstration setup was one of the booth's focal points, inviting visitors to look more closely at the model's outdoor-oriented protective design. With an IP65 rating for dust and water resistance, the portable power station gave the team a concrete starting point for discussing outdoor use, product protection and practical operating needs. Another memorable exhibit was an N1000 previously used by participants at Burning Man and featuring original artwork painted by several artists. Brought from the desert to RE+, the unit paired a real-world use story with a distinctive visual identity, showing how a power station can support outdoor experiences while becoming part of the memories people bring home. New Products Built Around Practical Details GEYOTO's next-generation N300L, N1000L and N2000L portable power stations put a familiar travel inconvenience in focus: managing charging cables. Each model features an integrated retractable cable that delivers up to 140W of fast charging to compatible devices, bringing cable storage and device charging together in one design. On the solar side, the S200 Rigid and S400 Rigid panels use heterojunction (HJT) cell technology and support bifacial generation, with a bifaciality rating of up to 95%. Reinforced aluminum frames are designed to support long-term outdoor use. The modular Y3000 and Y6000 balcony energy storage systems added another application to the display, with battery expansion options for different energy needs. Small Gestures Made Energy Useful on the Show Floor Beyond the displays, the team offered hats, charging adapters and cables, along with access to charging at the booth. For visitors who needed to recharge a device during the show, GEYOTO's products became part of their day rather than simply something to look at. For some visitors, interest went beyond filming and conversation. Several visitors asked to buy the equipment directly and take it home, and nearly all of the spare units available at the booth were purchased on site. The response gave GEYOTO a tangible sign of product appeal during its first RE+ appearance. As RE+ 2026 came to a close, GEYOTO left with new industry contacts, content from creators and attendees, and direct feedback from people who had seen and used its products. From a charging cable offered when a visitor needed one to a power station taken home after the show, the debut connected GEYOTO's products with real people and immediate needs, giving its "Go-to Energy" philosophy a practical expression. Reliable Energy Ready for Real Life. About GEYOTO GEYOTO develops portable power stations, solar panels and modular balcony energy storage systems, focusing on reliable energy solutions designed around everyday needs. ae.description: Players going for 100% in GTA 6 have 27 magazines, books and comics to find, along with 7 Book Swap locations. The completion checklist asks for 30 of those 34 items. Nobody has reported a trophy or cash reward, so the only payoff is checklist progress. These figures come from guide pages that went up on 18 November 2026, one day before launch. Every location here comes from a single guide. Check again after launch: we'll update this page as players report back. How many magazines, books and comics are there to read? Leaving out style magazines, there are 27 unique items. Each one only needs reading once. The game menu won't tell you which ones you've already opened, so keep track yourself. So far one guide has documented 20 of the 27, roughly 74 percent. It still lists the other seven as unknown, which means no full list exists yet. A few items point you to hunting or fishing spots, so they're worth reading even before you go for 100%.What are Book Swaps? Book Swaps are seven spots modelled on Little Libraries, where you can drop off and pick up books. Add them to the 27 items above and you get 34. The checklist asks for 30, and only unique copies count. Only one Book Swap has been documented: the Outback Gas Junkie in Waning Sands, Leonard County. The other six haven't been listed. The two checklists match on the total, and neither mentions a reward. Where do I track what I have read? Go to the progress menu, choose Collections and then Exploration. Book Swaps and Magazines, Books and Comics each get their own entry there, with a counter. Which items can I miss? The one guide that covers them ties several items to locations you can no longer reach once the story moves on. Only one source reports this so far, so grab those items early and don't test where the cutoff falls. ae.title: GEYOTO Wraps Up RE+ 2026 Debut with Strong Visitor Engagement and Real-World Product Experiences
ae.description: From creator coverage and product demonstrations to an artist-painted N1000, GEYOTO's Las Vegas debut connected energy innovation with everyday needs. LAS VEGAS, Nov. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- GEYOTO concluded its first appearance at RE+ 2026 with an active booth, interest among content creators and visitors, and product experiences that brought its "Go-to Energy" philosophy to life. During the Nov. 17–19 exhibition at the Las Vegas Convention Center, attendees stopped to photograph the booth, explore new products and speak with the team about energy needs at home and outdoors. A First Appearance That Gave Visitors a Reason to Stop At Booth C4753, sandstone textures and warm desert tones gave GEYOTO an American Southwest-inspired setting. The oversized "YO!" installation at the front added a playful welcome, expressing the brand's lively, approachable personality and giving visitors another reason to stop and take a photo. Content creators, including @911Reviews and @Minute Man Solar, visited the booth to explore and record the new lineup. Alongside invited creators, other attendees passing through the exhibition also stopped to film and photograph the products, drawn to their distinctive designs. Attendees shared their own photos and posts on social media, carrying their impressions of GEYOTO beyond the exhibition floor. Creators at the Booth This interest also led to conversations with distributors, retailers and solar industry professionals about product applications and potential North American partnerships, giving the team opportunities to continue discussions beyond the show. Product Stories That Went Beyond the Specification Sheet The N1500X demonstration setup was one of the booth's focal points, inviting visitors to look more closely at the model's outdoor-oriented protective design. With an IP65 rating for dust and water resistance, the portable power station gave the team a concrete starting point for discussing outdoor use, product protection and practical operating needs. Another memorable exhibit was an N1000 previously used by participants at Burning Man and featuring original artwork painted by several artists. Brought from the desert to RE+, the unit paired a real-world use story with a distinctive visual identity, showing how a power station can support outdoor experiences while becoming part of the memories people bring home. New Products Built Around Practical Details GEYOTO's next-generation N300L, N1000L and N2000L portable power stations put a familiar travel inconvenience in focus: managing charging cables. Each model features an integrated retractable cable that delivers up to 140W of fast charging to compatible devices, bringing cable storage and device charging together in one design. On the solar side, the S200 Rigid and S400 Rigid panels use heterojunction (HJT) cell technology and support bifacial generation, with a bifaciality rating of up to 95%. Reinforced aluminum frames are designed to support long-term outdoor use. The modular Y3000 and Y6000 balcony energy storage systems added another application to the display, with battery expansion options for different energy needs. Small Gestures Made Energy Useful on the Show Floor Beyond the displays, the team offered hats, charging adapters and cables, along with access to charging at the booth. For visitors who needed to recharge a device during the show, GEYOTO's products became part of their day rather than simply something to look at. For some visitors, interest went beyond filming and conversation. Several visitors asked to buy the equipment directly and take it home, and nearly all of the spare units available at the booth were purchased on site. The response gave GEYOTO a tangible sign of product appeal during its first RE+ appearance. As RE+ 2026 came to a close, GEYOTO left with new industry contacts, content from creators and attendees, and direct feedback from people who had seen and used its products. From a charging cable offered when a visitor needed one to a power station taken home after the show, the debut connected GEYOTO's products with real people and immediate needs, giving its "Go-to Energy" philosophy a practical expression. Reliable Energy Ready for Real Life. This new honor comes just two months after PexarBolt Ultra's initial launch at IFA 2026, where it was named a 2026 IFA Innovation Awards Honoree in the Content Creation Technology category. PexarBolt Ultra TBT5 Dock, a CES Innovation Awards® 2027 Honoree, with its 5-inch touch control dashboard PexarBolt Ultra's Kickstarter campaign has drawn more than US$740,000 from over 1,300 backers, including Late Pledges. As the world's first Thunderbolt 5 dock to feature a 5-inch touch control dashboard in a compact aluminum design, the PexarBolt Ultra shows the performance and status of connected devices in real time. The PexarBolt Ultra will also be on display at CES 2027 in Las Vegas, Jan. 6-9, at the Lexar booth (#24138, Central Hall, Las Vegas Convention Center). ae.title: Waterdrop X12-Alkaline Mineral pH+ Reverse Osmosis System Named a Good Housekeeping 2027 Home Reno Awards Winner
ae.description: LOS ANGELES, Nov. 21, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Waterdrop Filter announced that its flagship X12-Alkaline Mineral pH+ Reverse Osmosis System has been named a winner in Good Housekeeping's 2027 Home Reno Awards, earning recognition in the Kitchen Solution category under "Peak Water Protection." The award highlights the X12's advanced filtration, water efficiency and space-saving design, bringing high-performance reverse osmosis technology into everyday home kitchens. Good Housekeeping's 2027 Home Reno Awards recognizes products that improve home functionality, efficiency, safety and comfort. The evaluation process combines laboratory testing, consumer trials in real homes and feedback from industry professionals, offering homeowners independent insights when considering home upgrades. In its review, Good Housekeeping highlighted the evolution of reverse osmosis technology, traditionally recognized for its ability to reduce contaminants such as lead, arsenic and microplastics, but often associated with high water waste and bulky installation requirements. Good Housekeeping noted: "This system from Waterdrop shows how far the technology has come. It is compact enough to fit in an under-sink cabinet, and it produces three gallons of filtered water for each gallon that it wastes, basically flipping the 'pure-to-drain' ratio on its head." The Waterdrop X12 addresses these traditional limitations through several key features. Its 11-stage reverse osmosis filtration system reduces a broad range of contaminants, including TDS, PFOA, PFOS, fluoride, arsenic and lead. The system delivers up to 1,200 GPD of water production and can fill a 6-ounce cup in approximately three seconds. Its 3:1 pure-to-drain ratio helps improve water efficiency, while its compact, tankless design makes it practical for under-sink installation. The alkaline mineralization technology adds calcium and magnesium after filtration and adjusts the water's pH to approximately 7.5. Real-time TDS monitoring and filter-life indicators provide additional convenience for everyday use. The system's performance was also further evaluated through the Good Housekeeping Institute's testing process. Analysts first verified that the Waterdrop X12 was certified to meet NSF 58, among the most rigorous standards. DIY expert and judge Renee Bruner tested the system at home, giving it perfect marks for installation, performance and overall quality. "The flow rate is exceptional," she said, noting that it filled a glass of water nearly as quickly as the main kitchen faucet did. "More important, the water tastes significantly better than before the filter was installed," she added. Looking ahead, Waterdrop Filter will continue advancing reverse osmosis technology with a focus on filtration efficiency, installation convenience and everyday usability. Through ongoing product innovation, the company aims to make reliable, high-quality water filtration more accessible to households worldwide. About Waterdrop Filter Founded in 2015, Waterdrop Filter is a water purification company offering solutions for homes, offices and outdoor use. Its product range includes under-sink and counter-top reverse osmosis systems, pitchers and whole-house filters. With a mission to make clean water accessible worldwide, Waterdrop Filter provides water filtration products trusted by more than 40 million families globally. Learn more at www.waterdropfilter.com. za.title: Short film ''I AM ALEX'' by United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS) plays in five international film festivals
za.description: A UNAIDS short film delves into a South African township focusing on the battle against HIV/AIDS that goes beyond a medical issue. 'I am Alex' highlights the current realities communities face amidst inequality, poverty and unemployment. The film played at five film festivals notably the Jackson Documentary Film Festival and the Africa International Human Rights Film Festival and is now available to watch on UNAIDS YouTube. Director David Gough, a former journalist, returns to a place he once reported on two decades ago and juxtaposes the past horrors of the AIDS epidemic with the incredible progress made in the HIV response. "Despite this major progress in treatment and access and public health messaging, the reality on the ground remains deeply challenging," he said. "This film was motivated by a desire to understand what has and has not changed." The documentary follows the work of two local activists, Lebogang Seboni and in the longer film version Charles Mpephu, working at Men's Forum using grassroots methods to engage men in conversations about HIV, mental health, and vulnerability. Their efforts to provide community support, education, and safe spaces are central to how the response to HIV is evolving today. The approach? Practical, peer-led, and grounded in lived experience. Mr Gough worked with award-winning cinematographer, Christian Abi Abboud and used minimal equipment to keep the production unobtrusive. "The goal with 'I am Alex' is to give a broader understanding of how HIV intersects with social and economic challenges and the importance of community-based responses," Mr Gough said. "The HIV epidemic as you will see still requires sustained attention, empathy, and policy support." According to UNAIDS, approximately 64% of the 41 million people living with HIV globally live in sub-Saharan Africa, with Eastern and Southern Africa carrying the largest burden. Last year, 130 000 people acquired HIV in South Africa with 42 000 people dying of AIDS related illnesses. "The film exemplifies the many issues surrounding HIV and hints at despair but also hope," said UNAIDS Communications Manager, Charlotte Sector. UNAIDS thanks Men's Forum, The Humanitarian Cooperative and all the participants for their contribution. To watch, click the link here. Distributed by APO Group on behalf of United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS).

za.title: Chinese Embassy in Zambia Hosted 2026 Annual Reception for Zambian Alumni of China-Aid Training
za.description: On November 19, the Chinese Embassy in Zambia held the 2026 Annual Reception for Zambian Alumni of China-Aid Training. Ambassador Han Jing, Deputy Secretary to the Cabinet of Zambia Siazongo Siyakalenge, and more than 100 trainee representatives from Zambian government departments, research institutions, and other organizations attended the event Ambassador Han stated that human resources development cooperation is an important component of China-Zambia practical cooperation. In 2026, both the number of Zambian participants and the number of training programs increased significantly year on year. China is ready to work with Zambia to actively implement the outcomes of the Beijing Summit of the FOCAC, and provide talent and intellectual support for Zambia's economic and social development and pragmatic cooperation between the two countries. Siyakalenge said that the friendship between China and Zambia has a long history, and he conveyed sincere gratitude for the valuable long-term support from the Chinese government and people to the Zambian government and people. He expressed the hope to continue learning from China's experience in governance and economic development, further strengthen cooperation in human resources and other fields, and continuously advance the friendly relations between the two countries. At the reception, five trainee representatives shared their gains and insights from their training in China in areas such as "zero tariff," new energy, healthcare, and local governance. The event was warm and friendly. Distributed by APO Group on behalf of Embassy of the People's Republic of China in the Republic of Zambia.

mg.title: ARTS PLASTIQUES - Hasina Harimanana honorée
mg.description: L’artiste peintre et céramiste, connue sous le nom de Pixi, a reçu le titre de Chevalier de l’Ordre des arts et de la culture, à l’occasion du vernissage de son exposition « Becoming ». Quinze années de recherche, d’expérimentation et de création artistique trouvent une reconnaissance particulière. Hasina Harimanana Randriatsilofoniaina, alias Pixi, a été distinguée hier à Sahameva Klub par le ministère de la Communication et de la Culture, qui lui a décerné le titre de Chevalier de l’Ordre des arts et de la culture. Le directeur général de l’Agence nationale des arts et de la culture (ANAC) lui a officiellement remis cette distinction. La cérémonie a également marqué le vernissage de « Becoming », sa nouvelle collection de dix œuvres réalisées en 2026. À travers « Becoming », l’artiste explore l’idée du devenir, de l’évolution et de la transformation personnelle. Si les paysages abstraits, qui caractérisent habituellement son univers artistique, occupent une place importante dans ses créations, cette collection marque une nouvelle orientation avec un mélange d’abstraction et de portraits. Inspirée notamment par la soif de connaissance de Léonard de Vinci, elle traduit cette démarche d’exploration à travers différentes formes et expressions. Œuvre imposantes « Nous sommes façonnés par nos expériences, nos choix et nos rêves. Nous ne sommes jamais véritablement définis. Becoming, c’est aussi avoir le courage de sortir de ce que les autres attendent de nous et de tracer notre propre chemin », explique-t-elle. Cette recherche artistique accorde également une place particulière à l’émotion, notamment avec une œuvre représentant un enfant atteint d’albinisme et sa mère, considérée comme l’une des pièces maîtresses de l’exposition. Inspirée par sa sensibilité et son expérience de la maternité, Hasina Harimanana y exprime le lien protecteur entre une mère et son enfant, ainsi que le besoin de sécurité et de réconfort. Diplômée des Beaux-Arts et spécialisée en céramique, Hasina Harimanana développe depuis quinze ans une pratique artistique qui associe peinture, poterie et décoration sur verre et porcelaine. Son univers, nourri par les influences de Vincent van Gogh pour l’expressivité des couleurs et de Léonard de Vinci pour sa curiosité intellectuelle, s’inspire également de la nature et des expériences humaines. À travers ses créations, elle explore les matières, les textures et les formes, tout en partageant son savoir-faire en peinture et en céramique. Parmi les autres réalisations marquantes de sa carrière figure un tableau de grand format, mesurant trois mètres sur deux, qui témoigne de son goût pour les œuvres imposantes et la personnalisation des supports. Si l’artiste a déjà participé à plusieurs expositions, ce vernissage constitue une première dans son parcours. Avec « Becoming », elle franchit ainsi une nouvelle étape, entre reconnaissance institutionnelle et affirmation de sa démarche artistique. Cassie Ramiandrasoa
